Companies & brands linked to Israel – boycott reference

Compiled 5 Nov 2026 from bdsmovement.net, the UN OHCHR settlement database (Sept 2025), Who Profits, AFSC Investigate, the UN Special Rapporteur report A/HRC/59/23, Don't Buy Into Occupation, consumer apps (No Thanks, Boycat, The Witness), company filings and press reports. Stake % = ownership of an Israeli subsidiary / asset where documented; "n/a" = link is contractual, franchise, operational or political rather than an equity stake. Icons are embedded in this file (favicons fetched Nov 2026).

AXA

France · BDS official – consumer boycott priority target
n/a>2.5M shares (>$20M) in 3 Israeli banks at 30 Sep 2023 (Profundo via Ekō); reported fully/near-fully divested by mid-2024

Historical: AXA held shares in Israeli banks (Hapoalim, Leumi, Discount/Mizrahi) and Elbit Systems. Elbit was fully exited by end-2019; per Ekō/Profundo and BDS, AXA held >$20M in three Israeli banks at 30 Sep 2023 and had essentially exited by March-June 2024, with AXA saying in April 2024 it had no Israeli bank investments. Advocacy-sourced; no AXA filing found.

Appears on: BDS divestment (AXA targeted) · Albanese report A/HRC/59/23 · DBIO V 2025 report / DBIO IV 2024 report

Carrefour

France · BDS official – consumer boycott priority target
n/aFranchise only; no Carrefour equity found. Franchisee Global Retail: Electra Consumer Products 48% (Globes, Mar 2024)

In March 2022 Carrefour signed a franchise agreement with Israel's Electra Consumer Products and Yenot Bitan, whose franchisee Global Retail (Electra holds 48%) runs Carrefour Israel, including stores in settlements per BDS. I found no report of the franchise ending; BDS and French groups still call for termination (2026 France-Palestine statement).

Disney (Disney+, Marvel)

US · BDS official – consumer boycott priority target
n/aDonation, not an equity stake

On 12 Oct 2023 Disney pledged US$2M for humanitarian relief in Israel: US$1M to Magen David Adom and US$1M to regional nonprofits focused on children. BDS's stated reasons for targeting Disney+ are different: it accuses Disney of glorifying Israel's regime through actors as 'cultural ambassadors' and a character tied to Mossad.

Intel

US · BDS official – consumer boycott priority target
~80% of Mobileye (mid-2025; may be lower since)Mobileye: ~88% before July 2025; ~80% after the July 2025 sale (45M shares, ~$900M) per Times of Israel/Globes. Later sales reported; current % unverified.

Intel has large Israel operations (Kiryat Gat Fab 28, Haifa/Jerusalem R&D; reportedly ~12,000 employees; planned ~$25B Kiryat Gat expansion put on hold in 2024-25) and controls Israeli-founded Mobileye (Jerusalem) and owns Habana Labs (Israeli AI chip firm, acquired 2019). Intel's Mobileye stake was ~88% and was cut to ~80% by the July 2025 secondary offering; further sales were reported afterwards.

Microsoft (incl. Xbox)

US · BDS official – consumer boycott priority target
n/aContracts; partial service cut Sept 2025 (no equity stake)

Microsoft has major Israel R&D centres and acquired Israeli firms (e.g. Aorato, Adallom). It supplied Azure/AI services to the Israeli Ministry of Defence; on 25 Sept 2025 vice-chair Brad Smith said it 'ceased and disabled a set of services' (cloud storage and AI) for one MoD unit after Guardian/+972 reporting on Unit 8200 surveillance data on Azure. The wider IDF relationship continued.

US · BDS official – grassroots (organic) target

Leonardo

Italy · Divestment campaign target (BDS/AFSC/Who Profits/UN database)
30% (Italian state)AFSC: 30 M-346 trainers ~ $1B (2012); final four OTO Melara 76mm guns ~$100M; DRS trailer contract $15.4M (Dec 2023); Italian state owns 30%. Albanese: BNP Paribas $410M loans 2021-23, Barclays $228M 2024.

Leonardo supplied 30 M-346 trainers to Israel (2012 order, delivered by 2016) and naval guns (final guns delivered 2022); its US arm Leonardo DRS merged with Israel's RADA in 2022. Italian reports (Altreconomia, disputed by the government) allege component supply after 7 Oct 2023.
